opportunities.title: The Most Trusted Name in Physical Security Just Got Owned by ShinyHunters (Yes, Really)
opportunities.why_now: Brinks Home's breach disclosure and leaked files land days after a rival outlet flagged the 'famous brand in physical security' pwning — an irony too good to pass up.
opportunities.angle: Ironic breach recap: juxtapose Brinks' security marketing against the ShinyHunters leak, end with lessons on why 'physical security' brands still fail at digital basics

opportunities.title: Iran's Water Hackers Are in at Least 7 States Now — And Nobody's Patched the PLCs
opportunities.why_now: SecurityWeek confirms the Minnesota water attack has spread to six more states just as CISA issues a fresh warning, turning a local story into a national critical-infra crisis.
opportunities.angle: Rolling incident tracker/map format — state-by-state breakdown of affected utilities, attributed TTPs, and the patch-cadence failures that let it spread

opportunities.title: N-able Patched Its N-central RCE. Attackers Took Over Anyway — Here's the Incomplete-Fix Playbook
opportunities.why_now: N-able's own admission that its 'fix' failed to stop active exploitation is a rare public confirmation of a botched patch cycle in real time.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence postmortem: timeline of CVE disclosure, vendor fix, and re-exploitation, framed as a cautionary tale for RMM software everywhere

opportunities.title: A $88M Bitcoin Heist in 41 Minutes: How a Coldcard RNG Bug Became the Perfect Crime
opportunities.why_now: Two outlets (Hacker News and Bleeping Computer) confirm the same hardware wallet flaw is now linked to a record theft, giving hard numbers and a tight timeline for the breach digest.
opportunities.angle: Technical deep-dive on the RNG flaw plus a timeline reconstruction of the 41-minute drain, positioned as the 'CVE of the week' for crypto custody

opportunities.title: SonicWall's Latest CVEs Are Already Ransomware Fuel — Patch Cadence Report Card
opportunities.why_now: SecurityWeek reports active ransomware exploitation of 'recent' SonicWall vulns, making this a live patch-now-or-get-hit story.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence scorecard: list the CVEs, disclosure-to-exploit timeline, and which orgs are still exposed, with a call-to-action patch checklist
